name: build
description: How a change is built and handed over: the standing instructions in every session, a mode the operator switches on for one task with playbooks and a delegate that writes the code, bugs fixed test first, and the pull request as the one commit a change lands as. On request, a design sketched as competing candidates and built against the chosen one, several attempts at one task grafted into the best, and an adversarial review by reviewers on different models. For work no narrower skill fits, a phase list designed before the run and kept honest by a decision trail. A performance number vetted before it is reported, and the comments of a change cut to those the code cannot say. A correction is recorded in the mistake ledger, and a mistake that repeats becomes a check.
